display_name: C-wide - C-trend rules, mechanically chosen universe
thesis: The same experiment as B-wide, on the slower book. C-trend's rules are unchanged -- close>sma(200) as the regime filter, ema(20)/ema(50) as the trigger, ema(20) crossing back below ema(50) as the exit, 12% stop, 120-day cap, 5 slots at 18% -- and only the nine names change, from a hand-picked AI/semi list to the nine most heavily traded long-history index constituents by median dollar volume through the design cutoff. C-trend's own memo argues its edge comes from excluding speculative names whose golden crosses do not sustain; a liquidity screen is a different and much blunter way of excluding them, and this card measures what that costs. As with B-wide, a nine-name universe is swapped rather than widened, so universe and selection rule move together.
entry: close > sma(200) and ema(20) crosses_above ema(50)
